thread:
sasha: Heads up 50min planning. We need a tight battlecard + 3x SDR hooks for launch post and webinar. Focus: cloud platforms, API sellers, DIY infra vendors.
omar: Agreed. Quick asks: one metric for headline, 3 one-liners per competitor, and 1 technical appendix for SEs.
lucy: I pulled the latest bench. Headline stat candidate: "35% lower per-token spend at equivalent quality with caching & batching". It's conservative and defendable.
sasha: That works. Keep it customer-facing: no deep jargon.
chris: For cloud platforms: lead with "managed but unpredictable economics". Hook + rebuttal: "Managed endpoints are easy until the bill and tail latency spike. We give cost predictability + routing controls."
maria: For API sellers: "fast to start, hard to control". Hook: "Start with an API, scale with control 10m to prod without retooling." Rebuttal: "We let you pin versions, canary, and fallback to cheaper variants."
omar: For infra vendors: "you get control but you also get ops debt". Hook: "Avoid building an inference platform from scratch  we host, dedicate, or private deploy with KMS and audit logs."
lucy: SDR snippets (short):
- "Ship features now, avoid surprise invoices later."
- "Keep latency consistent during peaks  not just average latency."
- "Reserve capacity with SLAs for mission-critical apps."
sasha: Nice. Also include simple procurement handlers: commit vs on-demand, sample TCO calc link, and how Dedicated contracts map to throughput.
chris: Adding 2-line technical appendix for SEs: benchmarking methodology, workload specs, quant settings, and a link to the CSV. Include the small command we used to run the bench: ```python run_bench.py --model conv-1.2 --batch 32 --kvcache on```
maria: Webinar plan (45min): 12min narrative + 18min live demo (routing + canary rollback) + 10min benchmarks walk + Q&A. Demo checklist attached.
lucy: I'll prep a two-slide field pack: one pager + 3 quick rebut cards per opponent.
sasha: Can people review the draft battlecard in the doc by EOD tomorrow? https://redwood.internal/ml/launch-assets (placeholder). Tag edits with :pencil2:.
omar: I'll validate the numbers and add the TCO sheet.
maria: I'll author the KMS & compliance blurb for Private deployment page.
